name: AI phone answering for Sydney restaurants
serviceType: AI phone answering and reservation booking
description: Stop losing Sydney bookings to a phone nobody can reach. Biteperk's VocoTable answers every restaurant call in a warm Australian voice, checks availability, and books the table — 24/7. Built, hosted and supported in Sydney.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with restaurants in Sydney?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sydney is home — we're built, hosted and supported here — but VocoTable works for restaurants and venues right across Australia. Sydney venues just get the bonus of a team in the same time zone who knows the local suburbs and the rhythm of a Sydney Friday night.

mainEntity.name: How does AI phone answering work for a Sydney restaurant?

acceptedAnswer.text: You forward your existing venue number to your VocoTable line — about five minutes with Telstra, Optus or your VoIP provider. From then on, Bella answers every call in a natural Australian voice, checks your live availability, and writes the booking straight to your dashboard. No app for guests to download, no menus, no hold music.
Yes. Bella is trained on Australian English and tuned for local place names, so she pronounces the suburbs and streets your guests mention correctly — no overseas-call-centre feel.

mainEntity.name: Where is my call and booking data stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Australia. Audio is processed onshore, kept only as long as needed to confirm the booking, and never used to train outside models. Biteperk is Privacy Act compliant and your bookings always stay yours.

VocoTable starts at a flat $80/month with no per-cover or per-call fees, scaling up for busier venues and multi-location groups. Most Sydney venues make it back from the bookings they stop missing in the first week.
